description: Daily average exchange rate of the US dollar in Canadian dollars.

licence.name: Bank of Canada Terms of Use
licence.conditions: Free to use, copy and distribute. Attribute the Bank of Canada as the source and indicate any changes. Bank of Canada exchange rates are for statistical and analytical purposes only, not for executing trades.

access: Public. Free, no account or API key required. The Bank's terms prohibit circumventing its request limits.
retrieval_method: Bank of Canada Valet REST API: observations/{series}/json returns the full history of the requested series together with each series' label, description, unit and frequency. The response is stored unchanged as the raw file.
frequency_basis: declared by Bank of Canada (Business daily)
refresh_schedule: 17:15 ET same day and 11:30 ET next morning on business days (CRON_TZ=America/Toronto)

reproducibility_rating.basis: 2 retrievals produced the same raw data (sha256:fc544e382d7b...), on 2026-10-24

quality_notes: 2447 rows in raw file; 2447 rows in processed file (Canada). Missing values: 0 of 2447 observations have no value (0.0%): none. Validation passed.
known_limitations: Indicative daily average of quotes from 08:00 to 16:00 ET, not a transaction or fixing rate; the Bank says it is for statistical and analytical purposes only. Valet history starts 2017-01-03. Not published on market holidays

checks.detail: same columns and dimensions as the previous retrieval (version 1)
response carries the Bank's terms of use (https://www.bankofcanada.ca/terms/)

ai_use_note: The acquisition, processing and validation code was written with the help of an AI coding assistant (Claude, Anthropic) and reviewed by the project team. No data values were generated, edited or imputed by AI: raw files are stored exactly as published by the Bank of Canada, and the processed file is produced by the deterministic code named in retrieval_script.
